heading: Duties of other Federal agencies
lead: Any Federal entity conducting or supporting activities directly affecting the heritage area shall—

tree.text: consult with the Secretary and the Commission with respect to implementation of their proposed actions; and
to the maximum extent practicable, coordinate such activities with the Commission to minimize potential impacts on the resources of the heritage area.
